name: Hydrocortisone (Generic) Cream 2.5%, 30-g
description: Hydrocortisone (Generic) Cream 2.5%, 30-g; Hydrocortisone Cream 2.5% is a topical cream prescribed as an anti-inflammatory to treat redness, swelling, itching and other skin conditions. It works by blocking natural substances (histamines) that occur during an allergic reaction. This medication is also available in a 1% strength. Customers may receive this drug under the name Zymox.
